title: The Apothecary Diaries Star Teases the Biggest Change in Season 3
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and one of the most anticipated releases is The Apothecary Diaries Season 3. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Hyūganatsu , the story centers around Maomao, a young apothecary with a knack for solving mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: Chiikawa Anime to Temporarily Halt New Episodes
content: The official website for the anime of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss My Hero Academia
content: The anime industry is filled with shonen anime, but even amid the abundance of shonen series, My Hero Academia has emerged as one of the best, perfectly capturing what the shonen genre represents.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Video Game Anime Adaptation Finally Locks In Its Release Window
content: Anime adaptations of video games aren’t that common; however, at Gamescom 2025, it was announced that the 2019 Game of the Year winner, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice , would receive an anime adaptation, and fans have been patiently waiting for its release.
author: ComicBook

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's New Animated Trailer by Masami Ōbari Highlights Kim Kaphwan
content: SNK began streaming on Thursday an animated trailer for its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring DLC character Kim Kaphwan, who joined the game's roster on the same day.
author: ANN

title: 6 Years Later, Sword Art Online Fans Are Still Waiting on the Anime’s Future After Its Biggest Arc Ever
content: Sword Art Online is often credited for being the isekai anime that opened the floodgates for the genre steadily dominating the anime industry in the last decade, and for good reason.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney+, Hulu Raise Monthly Pricing on Streaming Plans in U.S. Again
content: The updated prices apply to new subscriptions as of Wednesday. Current subscribers will get a price change on or after October 21. The streamer previously raised its prices in October 2025, and before that raised its price in October 2024.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Dark New Fantasy of Fall 2026 Is Set to Perfect the Modern Shonen Formula and Go Beyond
content: The Fall 2026 season is only a week away, meaning the new anime arriving this Fall will begin releasing soon, and Crunchyroll, as the primary streaming platform, is gearing up for its new releases.

title: Global Stage Hollywood Screens World Premiere of Psyren TV Anime's 2nd Episode on October 3 With Original Creator Toshiaki Iwashiro
content: The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 4 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV . Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China. The anime stars: • Rikuya Yasuda as Ageha Yoshin • Mayuko Kazama as Sakurako Amamiya.
